subject: Control plane telemetry drop after connector upgrade — brief & follow-up
summary: Customer experienced intermittent control-plane telemetry and connection drops after a connector upgrade. Team coordinated a targeted rollback, validated heartbeat recovery, and agreed on longer-term fixes and credits.
messages:
From: Victor Morales <victor.morales@currentshealth.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, ops-team@currentshealth.com
Cc: support@currentshealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: [URGENT] Post-upgrade: control plane telemetry drops + API 504s

Hi Sean,

We completed the connector upgrade this morning (6:45am ET) and since ~07:50am we started seeing spikes in control-plane telemetry drops and intermittent 504s from the API gateway. Symptoms: older model endpoints in our private VPC return timeouts, agent heartbeats show "stale" for short windows, and the Console shows repeated reconnect attempts.

Attached are the heartbeat snippet and a small log bundle that captures the 07:50–08:00 window. Our SREs have temporarily re-routed critical traffic to a backup endpoint, but we need a root-cause or a rollback plan ASAP. This is impacting two customer-facing features.

Can you confirm whether Redwood pushed any control-plane or connector configuration change correlated with 06:45? Please advise next steps and expected time to mitigation.

Thanks,
Victor
VP Engineering — Currents Health

---
Attachments: connector-upgrade-20270219-logs.tar.gz (text bundle), currents-heartbeat-snippet.txt (text)

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Victor Morales <victor.morales@currentshealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:25:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Post-upgrade: control plane telemetry drops + API 504s

Victor — thanks for the quick heads-up and the logs. I'm escalating to our private deployments team and looping in Laura (control plane lead) and Markus (ops).

Immediate plan:
- Laura/Markus: can you validate whether the connector 1.4.2 rollout included the telemetry shim that changes agent keepalive throttling? If yes, we should pull the rollout and push a rollback to 1.4.1 for the affected VPCs.
- I'll open an incident (INC-20270219-234) and coordinate a brief bridge with Currents SREs; we'll target a 60–90 minute mitigation window.

Victor: please keep your backup routing in place and share any Syslog/ELB traces you can. We'll prioritize on-call resources.

Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:44:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Post-upgrade: control plane telemetry drops + API 504s

On it — reproducing locally against a recorded trace. Initial findings: the 1.4.2 connector introduced a background telemetry worker that aggregates keepalive pings on a 15s cadence; under certain node counts it batches and emits bursts that coincide with our control-plane rate limiter. When the burst hits, the leader-election path can stall briefly and a small percentage of agents drop.

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
- Stop the ongoing rollout for 1.4.2 (hold all remaining clusters).
- Trigger a targeted rollback to 1.4.1 for Currents' VPC (can be done per-region) — rollout should complete in ~20–30 minutes.
- Disable the telemetry-batcher flag remotely for affected clusters (feature flag fallback) so we don't need a full rollback if that proves faster.

Markus: can you coordinate the rollback and prepare a quick canary to validate heartbeat stability post-rollback? I'll prepare a short patch to the batcher for 1.4.3 if we need a forward fix.

Laura Bennett
Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Post-upgrade: control plane telemetry drops + API 504s

Victor, Sean — FYI we've initiated a targeted rollback to connector 1.4.1 for the Currents production VPC at 09:05 ET and are running a two-node canary against the region. Early telemetry shows heartbeats stabilizing in the canary (09:10–09:15 window). We'll run a staged rollout: canary -> 30% -> 100% if no regressions.

Monitoring steps:
- Heartbeat latency & missed-heartbeat rate (panel: private-vpc/currents/heartbeat)
- API 5xx rate (panel: private-vpc/currents/api-errors)
- Leader election logs for 09:00–09:30 (collected to logs bundle).

ETA for full closure: tentatively 09:45 ET. I'll post updates to the incident and share the runbook.

Attachments: postmortem-draft-20270219.md (strawman)

—Markus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
